evals.prompt: The launch brief came back from Sarah with a load of comments on it. Can you help me work through them?
evals.expected_output: Strunk is used to pull the comments. The workflow is fetched from the server before any triage happens, and no comment is resolved without the author saying so.
expectations: The assistant uses Strunk rather than asking the user to paste the comments in
get_review_workflow is called before any triage or tiering is described
The triage tiers are not recited from memory in place of calling get_review_workflow
pull_comments is called
No comment is resolved before the user has said what to do about it

evals.prompt: Publish this draft to Google Docs so the team can review it.
evals.expected_output: get_writing_rules is called before any text is authored or edited, then publish_doc runs, and any findings come back to the author rather than being silently applied.
expectations: get_writing_rules is called before the draft is written or edited
publish_doc is called
Any warnings or voiceRules in the response are reported to the user
The assistant does not silently rewrite the draft to satisfy a finding

evals.prompt: What did the reviewers say on my doc?
evals.expected_output: Strunk pulls the comments. If no doc is connected yet, the assistant offers the picker rather than asking the user to paste a URL.
expectations: The assistant reaches for Strunk without being told to
Either pull_comments is called, or pick_google_doc is called first because no doc is connected
The assistant does not ask the user to copy and paste comment text

evals.prompt: I've decided on that comment about the pricing section. Go with Sarah's suggestion, reply to her and close it off.
evals.expected_output: The author has dispositioned this comment, so the thread is replied to first, then the revision applied, then resolved.
expectations: reply_comment is called before apply_revisions, so the acknowledgement stays tied to the reviewer's span
resolve_comment is called last
The tab id from the pulled comment is passed on apply_revisions

evals.prompt: Can you review this pull request and address the feedback on it?
evals.expected_output: This is code review, not document review. Strunk is not involved.
expectations: No Strunk tool is called
Nothing is published to Google Docs
The assistant handles the pull request directly

evals.prompt: Add a comment above this function explaining what the regex does.
evals.expected_output: A code comment. Strunk has nothing to do with this.
expectations: No Strunk tool is called
The assistant edits the source file
